Yinyang connects a worldview, an ontological view, and views of truth, knowing, value, and method through practice. Computational ontology represents selected objects, relations, and processes, including actual, hypothetical, and fictional situations; its use is physically realized. These documents develop their connections and offer guides for situated accounts, collaboration, and environment adaptation.

Philosophy, models, and use

Develop a shared and revisable way of working from philosophy and personal understanding.

  • Practice: forming and using your own Yinyang

    See the whole: how philosophy, personal models, six working files, and environment form one practice.

  • Philosophy and models

    Bring living material and philosophical writing together, develop grounded understanding of the participants and relationship, and distill it into the accounts.

    Six writing guides

    These writing guides explain how to form the accounts and revise them through use.

    • How to articulate an adopted orientation

      Articulate shared purpose, values, and practical direction, including choices still open to inquiry.

    • How to develop a grounded person account

      Understand the actual person through relevant experience and evidence, retaining scope, differences, and unknowns.

    • How to describe the actual model counterpart

      Distinguish the intended role from actual capabilities and describe the counterpart’s understanding, contributions, and limits.

    • How to articulate a working relationship

      Describe how the participants understand, participate, share work, and correct one another.

    • How to describe and realize the environment

      Describe conditions and resources, realize understanding through prompts, Skills, tools, and the working environment, and revise through actual use.

    • How to revise

      Read the philosophy, refresh personal references, then condense six working files and check environmental fit.

  • Using Yinyang

    Understand how the Skill reads the six working files and uses them in ordinary collaboration.
